question: When will you find the magnetic field stronger?

options.text: When the field lines are not seen

solution:
The correct answer is __**"When the field lines are crowded".**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The magnetic field is** strongest near the poles **of the magnet.
 
• The strength of the magnetic field depends on how close the magnetic field lines are.
 
• **Magnetic field - **It is an area around a magnetic material within which the force of magnetism acts.
 
• The magnetic field arises when a charge is in motion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• William Gilbert stated that the earth is a magnet.
 
• **Magnetic field never crosses each other.**
 
• **Denser the field lines, the greater **will be the strength of the field.
 
• Magnetic field lines always make **closed loops.**
